The '''Circle of Kavaan''' was the name of a religious cairn located on the outskirts of [[Chinshassa]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shalyvane]]. The circle was a sacred place of worship for the indigenous [[Species/Legends|species]] known as the [[Em'liy/Legends|Em'liy]] and named for their [[Deity/Legends|god]] [[Kavaan]].

==Background==
At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] discovered that [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] forces had been setting up small outposts in [[Chinshassa]]. [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] ordered a squad of [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE bombers]] to raze the city and eradicate the Rebel influence. Many of the sacred stones at the Circle of Kavaan were laid waste and the site fell into ruin. The [[Em'liy/Legends|Em'liy]] people, their spirit broken, reverted to a state of barbarism and became a wandering tribe of nomadic warriors. The Emperor's propaganda machine projected a false story claiming that the site had been [[Cleansing of Shalyvane|destroyed]] due to a colony of [[Human/Legends|Human]] barbarians. Future generations of Em'liy warriors took this story as the truth and viciously guarded the ruins from all Human contact.

[[3 ABY/Legends|Three years]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], members of the flight group known as [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] landed on [[Shalyvane]] and visited the ruins. [[Pilot/Legends|Pilot]] [[Lumiya|Shira Brie]] told [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] the false story of the cairn's destruction claiming that when she was a young girl in Chinshassa, savage Em'liy marauders raided the site and slaughtered her family. After telling her tale, a tribe of Em'liy discovered the Rogues near the circle ruins and attacked them. The Rebels took cover behind the stones and fought back blasting at every warrior they could find. Shira Brie managed to get to her [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|fighter]] and rained [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire down upon the Em'liy, dispelling their forces.

A few days later, Luke Skywalker returned to Shalyvane and met an old Em'liy named [[G'hinji Dros]]. G'hinji told Luke the true story of the Circle of [[Kavaan]]'s history and Luke discovered that Shira Brie was actually an Imperial agent.

Shira Brie maintained a special [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] buried beneath the stone ruins of the Circle of Kavaan. It could only be activated by physical contact with Human [[Blood/Legends|blood]]. By pretending to partake in a blood-letting ritual at the circle, Shira was able to send coded communications to her true master, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. Luke later sliced open his own palm and used his blood to activate the holoprojector.

==Behind the scenes==
The Circle of Kavaan was created by [[Marvel Comics]] writers, [[David Michelinie]] and [[Walter Simonson|Walt Simonson]].
